subject: Oil drain: this is the engine oil drain plug, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Drain the sump".

mustShow.text: HERO: The engine oil drain plug seen end-on: a short plain external hex head (17 mm size) with a flat copper-coloured crush washer under the head. Do NOT depict its orientation: keep it a plain generic shape.
A thin flat copper-coloured crush washer sitting between the plug head and the oil pan surface.

mustNotShow: pan bolts and ribs (Pan fasteners and rib layout are not established for the automatic pan; left out)
